My pain is in the lower chest, the side of my chest on the left, and my upper chest. It’s also in my breast on the right and in the posterior chest wall on the right.
Thank you. Next question (one at a time): **Does the pain worsen with breathing in (deep inspiration) or coughing?**
I don’t know.

I don’t know.

Yes. I have swelling in my calf on the right and my calf on the left, and swelling in the tibia on the right.

I’m not sure.

I don’t know.

I don’t know.

I don’t know.
